basics.name: Romain Sickenberg
basics.label: Customer Experience Specialist
basics.summary:
Client-facing professional with a Software Engineering background, combining IT consulting client relations with hands-on public-facing event security work and a genuine, long-standing interest in Tesla and electric vehicles.

Comfortable guiding guests through a first contact, from greeting and needs assessment to representing a client's image in high-visibility public settings, in French, English and German.

Work authorization: Swiss Citizen. Available now. Valid driving licence.

work.name: Academic Work SA
work.summary: IT Consulting for diverse clients via Academic Work.

work.name: Securitas AG
highlights: Represented client image and security standards on behalf of **Securitas**, the **Olympic Museum** and **RTS** (Radio Télévision Suisse), including on-camera security presence during live public broadcasts.
Greeted, directed and screened guests through access control at high-attendance sporting events for **LHC Lausanne** and **Lausanne-Sport**.
Coordinated crowd flow and incident response as part of a multi-agent security team across venues.

work.name: Antistatique SA
work.summary: From Junior to mid-level Software Engineer & highest skill jump!

Owned technical delivery and led code reviews across small to medium-sized projects, including an **AWS**-hosted client platform, raising maintainability and development standards for the team.
